title: Review statement

balanced.title: Balances check out
balanced.description: Opening balance + {count, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}} = closing balance. Every transaction was read correctly.

unbalanced.title: Some numbers don't add up
unbalanced.hint: Compare with the PDF — a transaction may be missing or misread. You can reprocess the file from the Import page.

issues.balance_mismatch: Opening balance + movements = {actual}, but the statement says {expected}.
issues.running_balance_mismatch: Row {row}: running balance should be {actual} but the statement shows {expected}.
issues.no_transactions: No transactions were found in this statement.
issues.missing_balances: Opening or closing balance could not be read, so totals can't be verified.

flagged: {count, plural, one {# transaction needs a category — it's listed first.} other {# transactions need a category — they're listed first.}}

confirm.prompt: {count, plural, one {# transaction is still uncategorized. Confirm anyway?} other {# transactions are still uncategorized. Confirm anyway?}}
